M: We ordered about four hundred sixty this year. Does the rebate apply to all units or only those above five hundred?
W: The language is ambiguous. I will ask them to clarify before we compare the net cost with the competing bid.
M: Good. A lower headline price may not be cheaper once volume terms are included.

questions.question_text: What will the woman do before comparing the bids?

options.text: Calculate the rebate on every unit
